description_verbatim: I have holes put in my bathroom ceiling and wall to fix a broken pipe in 2020, and have been asking to have it fixed, and nothing has happened. People have been calling property standards, and the newspapers and so forth i don't want that. I just want you to fix what you did, thats all

Missing exterior door. Unit is completely missing its door (only unit in the row with none). Install the brown aluminum storm door removed from unit 43 (36x80, hinged left / latch right from outside) as donor. Before install: check door latch and screen condition; re-screen if needed; confirm opening and hinge side match. Do NOT log this under unit 43's bylaw WO.

Missing stove, renovated unit. Unit is completely missing a stove. Candidate: BLACK stove taken from 507 Days unit 15. CAVEATS: that stove is cockroach-infested and missing a few parts (which parts unknown) — pest clean/treat and a missing-parts check BEFORE install; do not install as-is. Stored white stoves at 511 basement / 107 Amherst are secondary candidates only. Note: the GE JCB3250SM1SS plate photo on file is from ANOTHER BD unit, NOT 507-15 — 507-15's own model is still to pull, and serial TM509193P must NOT be used for 263 parts.

Dishwasher not drain. Samsung dishwasher does not complete the wash cycle and does not drain. Model unknown — photograph the rating plate (door edge or inside tub) before ordering parts. Check first: drain hose high loop/kinks, standing water, drain pump/blockage, door latch, supply valve fully open. Display previously showed 86. Renovated unit.

Patio door screen ripped. Change the screen for the patio door. Access via Maxine, OK to Enter: No. Screen removed Nov 2, install screen into frame and refit, tenant told about two days, expected Nov 3-4.

Troubleshoot thermostat & heating. Thermostat not working / missing. Heat is central hydronic from the boiler room downstairs. Existing stat is old 2-wire (R + W). Field status Nov 2: coats in progress, install attempt after final coat, close-out waits on mount + all-radiators check.
Exhaust of dryer ripped. Repair the dryer exhaust in the laundry room.
